meta.name: avoid-ai-writing
meta.description: Audit and rewrite prose so it stops reading as machine-generated. Use this skill when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, edit a draft for AI tells, audit a README, changelog, release note, PR description, or blog post for machine-sounding prose, or make text sound less like AI. Supports a detect-only mode, a rewrite mode, and an edit-in-place mode, with optional voice and context profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让文稿读起来像真人写作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要让机器写的文案更像真人手笔
copy.tagline_en: Make any text read less like AI and more like you.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to remove AI-sounding phrasing from drafts and posts.

howto.what: Claude 会找出文本中读起来像机器生成的写法并列出问题,然后按你选的方式处理:默认重写并说明改了什么,也可以只做检测标记,或直接在原文件上就地修改。
howto.when: 当你要求去掉 AI 味、清理 AI 写作,或审计 README、更新日志、PR 描述等文本时触发。说“只检测”“扫描”这类词时,只标记不改写。

say.text: 帮我重写这段草稿,去掉 AI 味
say.note: 进入默认 rewrite 模式,附问题清单与改动说明

say.text: 只检测不要改:这篇博客里有哪些 AI 写作痕迹
say.note: 进入 detect 模式,区分明显问题与需自行判断项

say.text: 用 edit 模式清理 notes.md 里的机器腔
say.note: 就地改文件,引用、代码块、表格保持原样

howto.what_en: Claude finds the patterns that make text read as machine-generated and lists them, then either rewrites it (default), flags only, or edits a file in place, summarising what changed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to remove AI-isms, clean up AI writing, or audit a README, changelog or PR description. "Detect" or "flag only" switches to flagging without rewriting.

say_en.text: Rewrite this draft so it stops reading as AI-written
say_en.note: Default rewrite mode, with issues and a change summary

say_en.text: Detect only: what AI patterns are in this blog post?
say_en.note: Flags problems and judgment calls, no rewrite

say_en.text: Use edit mode to clean up the machine-sounding prose in notes.md
say_en.note: Edits the file in place, leaves quotes and tables
